save.title: Save view
save.name: Name
save.labelSelectorHint: Asked from the cluster, e.g. app=web,tier!=db. Leave empty for none.
save.captures: Saves the kind, namespaces, search text, Only problems, label selector, column filters, sort and visible columns.
save.full: The list of views is full. Delete a view first.

workspace.hint: A workspace shows only its clusters in the rail. Switching never connects or disconnects a cluster.

manager.title: Views and workspaces
manager.noViews: No saved views yet. Open a table and choose Save view in its header.
manager.deleteConfirm: Delete the view {{name}}? Its pins are removed too.
manager.deleteWorkspaceConfirm: Delete the workspace {{name}}? Its clusters, views and pins stay.

transfer.exportHint: Writes a JSON file with your views, pins, workspaces and the clusters by reference: the kubeconfig file path and the context name. Credentials, file contents, tokens and extensions are never included.
transfer.tooLarge: This export would be {{size}}, more than the {{limit}} Sextant can import. Remove some views or table filters and export again.
transfer.importHint: Shows what would change before anything is saved.
transfer.skippedHint: Its cluster is not on this computer
transfer.matchName: Matched by the context name only: it may be another cluster
transfer.agentAccessSkipped: Agent access rules are not applied: the cluster matched by name only
transfer.linksSkipped: Dashboard and trace links are not applied: the cluster matched by name only
transfer.filtersSkipped: Table filters are not applied: the cluster matched by name only
transfer.overwrite: Replace entries that differ from mine
transfer.applyAgentAccess: Apply the agent access rules from the file
transfer.agentAccessWarning: Agent access rules decide what AI agents may do in a cluster. Apply them only from a file you trust.
transfer.applyLinks: Apply the dashboard and trace links from the file
transfer.linksWarning: Links decide which addresses Sextant opens with the names of this cluster's objects in them. Apply them only from a file you trust.
transfer.nothing: Nothing to import with these choices.
